Bash(PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "
import sqlglot
for cmd in [
    'select 1 \\$\\$ \\$> out.txt',
    'select 1 \\$| cat \\$>> out.txt',
    'select 1 \\$> out.txt',
    'select 1 \\$>> out.txt',
]:
    tokens = sqlglot.tokenize\(cmd\)
    print\(f'--- {cmd} ---'\)
    for i, t in enumerate\(tokens\):
        print\(f'  [{i}] {t.token_type.name:20s} text={t.text!r:15s} start={t.start} end={t.end}'\)
    print\(\)
")
